name: Panagia tou Araka
description: One of ten painted churches in the Troodos on the UNESCO list. From outside it's a barn with a steep timber roof; inside it's a complete cycle of twelfth-century Byzantine frescoes, unrestored, in the original colours.
getting: In Lagoudera, an hour of mountain road from Nicosia. The key is held locally and the priest opens it — turning up mid-morning is the reliable approach.
